_about: radar-lab/TransRAD Train.py at 8f9b9ad, run as shipped with model_path cleared (train from scratch) and phi 'n'. Every value below is the script's EFFECTIVE value, not the paper's prose: Init_lr_fit = min(max(batch/64 * 1e-3, 3e-4), 1e-3) = 3e-4 at batch 4 (the paper says 1e-3), Min_lr_fit = 3e-6; cos schedule from get_lr_scheduler: warmup_epochs = min(max(0.05*100, 1), 3) = 3 (quadratic, from warmup_lr_start = max(0.1*lr, 1e-6) = 3e-5), cosine to epoch 95, last min(max(0.05*100,1),15) = 5 epochs held at min_lr; Adam betas (momentum 0.937, 0.999), weight_decay 0; EMA decay 0.9999 with tau 2000 (ModelEMA); grad clip 10 (utils_fit.py:34); seed 11; drop_last on train/val loaders; best checkpoint = lowest EMA val loss (utils_fit.py:106), which Test.py then evaluates.
_split_note: The reference holds out the last 5% of an UNSORTED glob of the train directory (about 406 frames) and trains on the rest; this config uses the repo's official split (7314 train / 812 val, original_split_info.json) for comparability with the RADDet and DAROD rows. The 2032-frame test set is identical. Test.py uses batch 12 with drop_last and so scores 2028 frames; here all 2032 are scored (the evaluator normalises per frame).
_eval_note: eval_input_size is the cube on disk [range, azimuth, doppler]: the decoder scales Doppler back from the resized 256 to 64 and the 3D IoU uses that size (config.json MODEL.input_shape). confidence/nms/la_nms thresholds are yolo.py _defaults (0.3, 0.1) and detect_image line 98 (0.1). mAP_iou3d_threshold_list is Test.py's mAP_iou3d_threshold; the primary 0.3 drives the val curve.
